title: Open the octave garden
story: Eight stepping stones cross the whole natural octave from low C to high C.
childCue: Choose any stone, inspect its holes, hear it, then see whether the garden recognises it.
adultCue: This is an explorer, not a one-sitting test. Baroque F is the forked 0-1-2-3-4-6-7 pattern; both halves of split holes are covered.
successCue: You explored every natural note in the garden!
tips: Explore one new stone at a time.
Forked F is the Baroque clue.
